Title: Post-Meal Bloat? It Might Be These 3 Hidden Habits, Not Your Food

Description:
If your stomach feels tight and bloated after eating, even on a day you ate clean, the problem might not be your meal at all. Sugar alcohols in protein bars and shakes, raw cruciferous veggies like broccoli and kale, and sipping drinks through a straw can all quietly build up gas in your gut.

Small swaps make a real difference: pick monk fruit or stevia sweetened bars, steam your veggies instead of eating them raw, and skip the straw.

Watch to see exactly why each one happens and how to fix it.
